content.text:
Please extract all math exam questions from this Edexcel A-level question paper page image.

For each question and sub-question (even without text or marks), return:
- question_number (e.g., "2")
- level: one of "main" or "sub"
- label: e.g., "2", "(a)"
- marks: number or null
- question_text: a string, preserving all original line breaks, containing all relevant text (can be empty if no visible content)

📌 Sub-question rules:
- If a sub-question (e.g., (a)) contains recognisable sub-parts like (i), (ii), etc., **do not split them** — keep them embedded in the `question_text` field.
- If there is content between two sub-questions (e.g., between (a) and (b)) that is not labeled as a new part, allocate it contextually to the **most relevant** sub-question based on position and meaning.

📌 Output format:
[
  {
    "question_number": "2",
    "level": "sub",
    "label": "(a)",
    "marks": 3,
    "question_text": "(i) Show that ...\n(ii) Hence find ...\n[extra contextual text]"
  },
  {
    "question_number": "2",
    "level": "sub",
    "label": "(b)",
    "marks": 2,
    "question_text": "..."
  }
]

Do not skip any question, even if it includes diagrams, graphs, or formulas.
Extract all mathematical instructions, assumptions, and visible mathematical expressions.
Treat diagrams and associated text as part of the relevant question or sub-question.
Only return a raw JSON array of question objects. Do not include any explanation, markdown, or commentary.
